Seven years of light,
seven years of grace—
you’ve walked the stage and screen
with a spirit that never fades.

Through every role,
you’ve given us more than art—
Seeing you achieve your goals,
envelops us all in so much warmth.

Thank you for inspiring us
to dream a little higher,
to keep going when it’s hard,
to burn brighter with our fire.

Today we celebrate you—
not just for the star you are,
but for the kindness and strength
that shine even brighter than the stars.

Here’s to your seventh year,
and to all the years ahead—
may your journey bloom endlessly,
just as you’ve bloomed in our hearts.
